dct_description_sm: HRDPA is ECCC’s high-resolution precipitation analysis, merging gauge, radar, and HRDPS model data. CaPA-HRDPA produces four analyses of 6 hour amounts per day, valid at synoptic hours (00, 06, 12 and 18 UTC) and two 24 hour analysis valid at 06 and 12 UTC. A preliminary production is started 1 hour after valid time and a final one is launched 7 hours later. This translates into a production of 12 analyses per day.
dct_title_s: HRDPA Observed Accumulated Precipitation - Past 7 days ONLY- WEBMAP
